# DigitalOcean — DigitalOcean Startups

12 months of DigitalOcean credits set per startup by the approving partner, plus 15 months of free Standard-tier support. Participants generally have a $10,000 monthly credit usage limit.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - the vendor publishes no amount |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-16 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [☁️ Cloud](../categories/cloud.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Credits are used over the 12-month term of the program; free Standard-tier paid support runs 15 months. |
| **When it ends** | If you go over the monthly credit limit, you will be charged for the additional usage for that month. |


### Not covered

- GPU Droplets
- NVIDIA H100 GPU Kubernetes
- Bare Metal GPUs
- Dedicated Inference
- Serverless Inference and third-party AI models hosted outside DigitalOcean infrastructure (including Anthropic and OpenAI)
- Paperspace Machines
- Cloudways services
- Any other charges passed through to third-party providers
- Service-based startups (consulting, web/app development, marketing agencies) are not eligible

> **Stacking:** GPU credits are a separate benefit not covered by core credits; acceptance into the program does not entitle a startup to GPU credits, which are awarded to select customers after a separate GPU credit application.

### Notes

The requested URL https://www.digitalocean.com/hatch now 301s in-domain to https://www.digitalocean.com/startups; the program is branded "DigitalOcean Startups", not "Hatch" (the Typeform slug is still /hatch). No credit amount is published — award level is set by the DigitalOcean Startups partner. Service-based startups (consulting, web/app development, marketing agencies) are explicitly not eligible, and DigitalOcean states it prioritises AI-native startups. The benefit is quoted as "12 months of DigitalOcean credits to easily deploy and scale your infrastructure" - no dollar amount is published. Also verbatim: "This program is for new startups that have not used prior credits with DigitalOcean." A VC or accelerator is optional; applicants may select "Other".
